evidence: Labeled 'Build system', modifies CMake compiler feature checks (cmake/module/CheckCXXFeatures.cmake), and updates CI base images and workflows.
rationale: Raising minimum GCC to 13.1 enables std::format support and standard static_assert in dependent contexts while paving the way for C++23. As a strategic compiler dependency transition, it unlocks codebase-wide modernization and eliminates legacy workarounds.
